title: SMP userspace scheduler and PELT rollout
summary: Establish authoritative per-task and per-hart SMP scheduling, accept static then movable userspace execution, evaluate event-driven PELT with matched A/B evidence, and shard task/wake storage only when measured lock contention justifies it.

steps.title: Align active reactor, scheduler, SMP, and ThreadRuntime contracts
steps.notes: Pin TaskControl authority, run-token epochs, local-hot and remote-cold queue endpoints, lock-and-recheck wake, userspace migration-safe unwind, and advisory-only PELT before code behavior changes.

steps.title: Centralize task authority and linearize queue membership
steps.notes: Introduce TaskControl, RunToken, PollLease, queue and lease epochs; move lifecycle and owner truth out of shared scheduler metadata; preserve 10 ms and 1 ms budget semantics.

steps.title: Close wake, IPI coalescing, trap-return, and WFI races
steps.notes: Wake rechecks current_hart under shard then TaskControl locks, falls back to one per-hart ingress token after bounded retries, coalesces IPIs, and uses a two-recheck polling-idle/WFI protocol.

steps.title: Accept S1 authoritative SMP correctness
steps.notes: S1 requires zero lost wake, duplicate valid token, simultaneous poll lease, owner mismatch, generation confusion, or missed reschedule while legacy pinned behavior remains available.

steps.title: Enable and accept static AP userspace placement
verification: cargo xtask test smp-scheduler-witness --target rv64-qemu --case static --timeout-ms 60000
steps.notes: Parse immutable legacy/static/movable and depth/pelt-shadow/pelt modes. Static mode spreads four user tasks across four harts and pins each after placement; excluding the owner remains ENOSYS until S3.

steps.title: Validate full userspace token unwind before migration
steps.notes: Every userspace round trip carries TaskKey, run_seq, and hart; syscall, fault, timer, and Reschedule paths clear old identity/payload/token slots and inactive resume context before publishing Preempted.

steps.title: Add idle-first direct steal and forced affinity migration
steps.notes: Only Preempted.front is stealable; success directly returns a thief-owned PollLease. Forced affinity handles Parked, Queued, and Polling separately and cannot return userspace on a disallowed hart.

steps.title: Accept movable userspace with SMP guest stress
verification: cargo xtask test smp-scheduler-witness --target rv64-qemu --case movable --timeout-ms 60000
cargo xtask test smp-scheduler-witness --target rv64-qemu --case pipe --timeout-ms 60000
cargo xtask test smp-scheduler-witness --target rv64-qemu --case affinity --timeout-ms 60000
cargo xtask test smp-scheduler-witness --target rv64-qemu --case timer --timeout-ms 60000
cargo xtask test smp-scheduler-witness --target rv64-qemu --case pthread --timeout-ms 120000
cargo xtask test smp-scheduler-witness --target rv64-qemu --case mixed --timeout-ms 120000
cargo xtask test smp-scheduler-witness --target rv64-qemu --case stress --timeout-ms 120000
steps.notes: Require load-skew spread, lossless cross-hart pipe wake, affinity-only execution after boundaries, zero stale timer slot consumption, pthread create/join, mixed progress, and zero token/lease/owner/generation invariants.

steps.title: Add Q32 PELT accounting, shadow decisions, and stable metrics
steps.notes: Use event-driven Q32 decay with a 1.024 ms period and 32-period half-life. PELT affects no correctness or slices; shadow executes depth choices while recording candidate disagreement.

steps.title: Evaluate and conditionally promote active PELT
verification: cargo xtask test smp-scheduler-witness --target rv64-qemu --case stress --sched-load pelt --timeout-ms 120000
steps.notes: Require five interleaved complete A/B pairs, at least 20% median pressure-imbalance area reduction, at least 98% median throughput, and wake p99 no worse than 105% of depth. Failed promotion leaves shadow mode available and active pelt rejected.

steps.title: Measure whether shared task and wake locks justify sharding
verification: RUSTFLAGS="--cfg tx_lock_metrics --cfg tx_lock_metrics_reactor" cargo test -p tx-reactor lock_metrics -- --nocapture
five complete movable SMP4 stress, pthread, and mixed lock captures
steps.notes: Trigger segmented storage only when shared task-table, scheduler-meta, and compatibility-wake total wait is at least 5% of summed task runtime and one shared lock wait p99 is at least 10 us in two workloads. Otherwise set the sharding step to canceled with the measurement-gate result.

steps.title: Conditionally shard task storage and direct all raw wakes per hart
verification: default and tx_reactor_segmented_tasks host correctness parity
five interleaved S4 and S5 complete A/B pairs
targeted shared-lock total wait at least 30% lower
median throughput at least 98% of S4
steps.notes: If triggered, use immutable published task segments, sharded allocation free lists, per-task control locks, and direct per-hart raw wake ingress. If the trigger or promotion gate fails, retain the measured old path and record the step as canceled with evidence.

steps.title: Run final host and guest matrix and catch up active docs
steps.notes: Repeat legacy/static/movable guest acceptance under the shipped load/storage mode, fault-decode every serial log, document only promoted behavior, and name exact defaults, artifacts, blockers, and next performance owner.

verification.notes: Passed on 2026-08-05; seven pre-existing active-doc stale-vocabulary discussion warnings remain non-fatal.
Passed on 2026-08-05 for 42 progress JSON files including this plan.
Passed on 2026-08-05 before staging the plan artifacts.

risks: Queue and task authority can remain split if compatibility methods survive outside the transition core.
A Reschedule IPI can still miss userspace arbitration if ack, ipi_armed, and polling-idle ordering are changed independently.
Movable userspace is unsafe until every trap path clears the exact old-hart run token and resume context.
PELT can appear beneficial from unmatched images, incomplete traces, or host-load drift; only five interleaved complete pairs count.
Segmented storage can add owner and recycle complexity without benefit; implementation is conditional on the explicit lock trigger.
blockers: Implementation has not started; the next action is Task 1 canonical contract alignment in an isolated execution workflow.
Active PELT and segmented storage remain promotion candidates, not promised defaults.
